title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation given is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This equation predicts $$self_{rating}$$ based on $$critic_{1's}$$ rating. Consider how changes to $$self_{rating}$$ might affect the parameters in this equation.

title: Effect of Subtracting the Mean
text: Subtracting the mean from $$self_{rating}$$ changes the scale of $$self_{rating}$$ but does not affect the relationship between $$self_{rating}$$ and $$critic_1$$ in the model equation. Think about how this operation impacts the parameters $$\theta_0$$ and $$\theta_1$$.

title: Impact on $$\theta_1$$
